home.hero: Launch your event and sell tickets in minutes.
home.heroSub: Accept Pago Móvil, Zelle and cash, convert to Bs with automatic BCV rate, and validate tickets with QRs.
home.attendeeBannerTitle: Are you an attendee looking for your ticket?
home.attendeeBannerCta: Ask the organizer for the event link they shared with you.
home.vp1Desc: Accept Pago Móvil, Zelle and cash. No foreign gateways.
home.vp2Desc: Sell in USD or EUR and collect in Bs with the BCV rate updated automatically.
home.vp3Desc: Built-in browser scanner: validate tickets instantly, no queues, no extra hardware.
home.vp4Desc: Invite collaborators and delegate payment approvals and scanning by role.
home.orgJourneySub: You're in control of the whole event, from start to finish.
home.orgStep1Desc: Set ticket types, price phases and complimentary tickets in minutes.
home.orgStep2Desc: Share your link and accept Pago Móvil, Zelle or cash, with approval and verification.
home.orgStep3Desc: Validate every QR with the built-in scanner and monitor attendance live with your team.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to run your event
home.featuresSub: From the first sale to the last QR scanned at the door.
home.feature1Desc: See tickets sold, revenue and pending approvals at a glance. Filter by event and by price phase.
home.feature2Title: Verify every payment without wasting time
home.feature2Desc: Receive the proof, review it and approve in one tap. The Bs conversion at the BCV rate is calculated for you.
home.feature3Title: Control the door with anti-fraud QR
home.feature3Desc: Every ticket carries a unique QR. Scan it at the entrance and prevent duplicates or resale.
home.faqQ1: How do I receive the money from my sales?
home.faqA1: Attendees pay you directly via Pago Móvil, Zelle or cash. You approve each payment; maTickets never holds your money.
home.faqQ2: Do I need special hardware to scan the QR codes?
home.faqA2: No. The scanner runs in your phone or tablet browser; all you need is the camera.
home.faqQ3: Can I sell in dollars and collect in bolívares?
home.faqA3: Yes. You set prices in USD or EUR and the platform converts to Bs with the BCV rate updated automatically.
home.faqA4: Yes. Invite collaborators and delegate payment approvals and door scanning according to their role.
home.faqQ5: Does it work for private or invite-only events?
home.faqA5: Yes. You can create guest lists with magic links, in addition to open-sale events.
home.ctaFinalSub: Create your event and start selling today. No card required.
